native_context: Coupon, credit and benefit redemption limits
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Coupon, credit and benefit redemption limits — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read benefit eligibility, account/order binding, stacking, one-use constraints and debit/credit ledger behavior. Record expiry and legitimate multi-use rules.
controls.controlled_verification: In an owned synthetic account/order redeem one benefit, then one bounded prohibited repeat or stacking case justified by policy. Compare durable redemption and benefit/debit totals, including error responses and retries. Use local deterministic concurrency only if a race is the actual hypothesis.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Multiple successful responses do not prove multiple credits. A deliberately reusable coupon is not a one-use bypass. Separate accounting, eligibility and concurrency root causes.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Enforce eligibility and atomic benefit/debit/idempotency at the ledger boundary. Retest valid redemption, the original repeat/stack and failure rollback.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
